key.text: A two-minute video interview with a professor for a class project. I need a camera, a microphone and a quiet place to film.

needs.why: Need a camera to film the interview.
Need a microphone for clear audio.

steps.title: Plan your interview
steps.detail: Write down your interview questions and check how long your two-minute video will take.

steps.title: Reserve the studio
steps.detail: Email spaces@usc.edu to reserve the podcast studio, or call the ITS Learning Environments team at (213) 821-6601.

steps.title: Record the interview
steps.detail: Go to the Digital Creative Lab in Leavey Library at your reserved time and use the studio equipment to record.

routes.process: Record the interview in a podcast studio

warnings.fix: Practice reading your questions beforehand to keep the interview concise.
warnings.issue: Running over the two-minute time limit

routes.fit_reason: This quiet studio provides built-in microphones and video recording equipment ideal for beginners. You can easily reserve the space by following the instructions.

steps.title: Plan your interview
steps.detail: Prepare your interview questions and find a quiet room to use for filming.

steps.title: Contact the lab
steps.detail: Email the lab at lvy@usc.edu to ask what you can use and when.

steps.title: Collect the equipment
steps.detail: Visit Ahmanson Lab in Leavey Library to pick up the camera and microphones.

routes.process: Borrow a camera and microphones to film elsewhere

warnings.fix: Choose a small, quiet room with soft furnishings to reduce echo.
warnings.issue: Background noise in a normal room

routes.fit_reason: You can check out a professional camera and wireless microphones to film in a quiet location of your choice. Email the lab staff to arrange equipment pickup.

output.summary: A two-minute video interview using a camera, microphone, and quiet studio space.
